entities.summary: İhsaniye is a town of Afyonkarahisar Province in the Aegean region of Turkey. It is the seat of İhsaniye District. İhsaniye district has a total population of 27,904 according to the 2024 census. The mayor is Emine Gökçe (AKP). The town consists of 8 quarters: Cumhuriyet, Şahinler, Hürriyet, Zafer, Susuzosmaniye, Fatih, Yenikent and Akören.
